class: Any code that turns a STORED contract id into a live price through its exchange feed key (segment:token) without checking that the contract is still live and still holds that token prices the wrong instrument once the exchange reuses the token for a new contract after expiry or delisting.
mechanism: public.catalogue_contracts keeps (exchange_segment, exchange_token) unique among LIVE contracts only (catalogue_store.py); a retired or delisted row keeps its old token, and a later live contract may hold the same token. A reader that does load_contract(id) -> f"{segment}:{token}" -> live quote gets the new contract's price.

first_seen.where: W-122 Start tracking view (backend/ofo_app/routes/tracking.py:181-185 _entry_legs, head 0bd5f562), Tier A round-2 verifier on the shared ofo_test database
first_seen.evidence: tracking started on a NIFTY iron condor; leg 0's contract (22800 CE, expiry 10-13) delisted; a new live contract (26000 CE, expiry 11-24) inserted on the same token NSE_FO:44624; GET tracking view -> 200 LIVE paper_pnl 195.00 with leg 0 current_price 45.15, the NEW contract's quote. A retired leg also answered 200 LIVE.

fix: W-122 round 3 (21642978): one helper backend/ofo_app/tracked_contracts.py resolve() is the only path from a stored contract id to a feed key in the tracking code; it returns a key only when the row is live AND live_contract_id(token) is the same id; every other case is a named state (contract_retired, contract_delisted, token_reassigned, contract_missing) and the view answers PAUSED with pause_reason; Start tracking refuses them. Mutation: identity check removed -> LIVE != PAUSED.
